headline: TWICE's NAYEON drops MV for 'BOY' from 'NA-sty'
sub: The track she named her favorite on the new single gets its own video
source: Source: JYP Entertainment official YouTube, via Korean media
caption:
TWICE's NAYEON has released a music video for 'BOY,' the closing track of her new single 'NA-sty.'

The MV dropped Nov 26 on JYP Entertainment's official channel, six days after the single came out with title track 'BABY ANGEL.' 'BOY' is a dreamy electronic R&B pop song with a flute line and a feature from rapper Lil Cherry. NAYEON picked it as her favorite of the three tracks. 'NA-sty' is her first solo release in about two years.
